uz: Stansiya shovqini nazorat qilinadi — turbina, transformator va ventilyatorlar shovqin chiqaradi. Shovqin himoyasi ishchilar salomatligi uchun muhim.
en: Plant noise is controlled — turbines, transformers and fans produce noise. Noise protection matters for worker health.

uz: DCS 'distributed' (taqsimlangan) deyiladi, chunki boshqaruv bitta kompyuterda emas, ko'p kontrollerlarga taqsimlangan — biri ishlamay qolsa, tizim to'xtamaydi.
en: A DCS is called 'distributed' because control is spread across many controllers, not one computer — if one fails, the system keeps running.
